meta.source_file: 医疗器械四国注册清单_工作初稿.xlsx

title.zh: 四国医疗器械注册清单
title.en: Medical Device Registration Checklist: Four Markets

assumption.zh: 适用假设：境外制造商的一般医疗器械，非 IVD。中国 III类需在各市场重新分类。
assumption.en: Assumption: general medical devices from a foreign manufacturer, not IVDs. A China Class III device must be reclassified in each market.

disclaimer.zh: 工作初稿，非产品最终申报清单。生成日期：2026-11-01（本机日期）。官网访问未取得可留存正文，现行要求须复核。
disclaimer.en: Working draft, not the final submission checklist for any product. Generated 2026-11-01 (local machine date). The official websites could not be accessed to retain reviewable text; current requirements must be re-verified.

pending.zh: 待补充：产品名称/型号、预期用途、植入/无菌/IVD属性、制造商所在地、现有 CE/ISO 13485/NMPA证书及拟上市日期。
pending.en: To be completed: product name/model, intended use, implantable/sterile/IVD status, manufacturer location, existing CE/ISO 13485/NMPA certificates and planned launch date.

no_fees.zh: 不预填固定费用/周期。最终分类、临床、当地代表、语言和专项认证须根据具体产品及申报时现行法规确认。
no_fees.en: No fixed fees or timelines are pre-filled. Final classification, clinical requirements, local representative, language and special certifications must be confirmed for the specific product under the regulations in force at the time of submission.

progress_note.zh: 适用性与进度分开维护。未完成产品分类和材料差距评估前，不应将任务状态视为申报就绪。
progress_note.en: Applicability and progress are tracked separately. Until product classification and the documentation gap assessment are complete, task status must not be read as submission-ready.

sources_note.zh: 以下为官方入口和法规标识，不是已留存的逐项最新条文证据。本次访问未能取得可复核正文，执行前须复核。
sources_note.en: These are official portals and regulation identifiers, not retained evidence of the latest text of each requirement. Reviewable text could not be obtained during this visit; re-verify before acting.

pathway.zh: SFDA医疗器械上市许可 MDMA

local_entity.zh: 沙特授权代表及适用经营主体
local_entity.en: Saudi Authorized Representative and applicable licensed establishments

key_documents.zh: 技术文档、QMS、性能/临床、标签和授权文件
key_documents.en: Technical documentation, QMS, performance/clinical evidence, labeling and authorization letters

premarket_checks.zh: 许可范围、本地资质、语言及 Saudi-DI
premarket_checks.en: Authorization scope, local licenses, language and Saudi-DI

classification.en: ANVISA Class III/IV usually requires registro

pathway.zh: 巴西境内持有人向 ANVISA申请注册
pathway.en: Brazilian registration holder applies to ANVISA for registration

local_entity.zh: 持有人、进口商及 AFE/本地许可
local_entity.en: Registration holder, importer and AFE/local licenses

key_documents.zh: 技术卷宗、GMP/CBPF、葡语资料；INMETRO依产品适用
key_documents.en: Technical dossier, GMP/CBPF, Portuguese documentation; INMETRO where applicable to the product

premarket_checks.zh: 产品分组、场地、注册范围及特殊认证
premarket_checks.en: Product grouping, sites, registration scope and special certifications

classification.zh: EU MDR Annex VIII重新判定
classification.en: Reclassify under EU MDR Annex VIII

pathway.zh: MDR符合性评估及 CE，不另假定德国独立注册证
pathway.en: MDR conformity assessment and CE marking; no separate German registration certificate is assumed

local_entity.en: EU AR, PRRC, importer and other economic operators

key_documents.zh: NB、技术文档、临床证据、DoC、UDI及德语资料
key_documents.en: NB, technical documentation, clinical evidence, DoC, UDI and German-language documentation

premarket_checks.zh: EUDAMED现行模块/期限、MPDG和德国本地义务
premarket_checks.en: Current EUDAMED modules/deadlines, MPDG and German national obligations

classification.zh: 按土耳其现行器械法规判定
classification.en: Classify under current Turkish medical device regulations

pathway.zh: 合规/CE证据及 ÜTS企业和产品登记
pathway.en: Conformity/CE evidence plus ÜTS company and product registration

local_entity.zh: 土耳其 AR、进口商及 ÜTS主体
local_entity.en: Turkish AR, importer and ÜTS-registered entity

key_documents.zh: 证书、DoC、技术资料、土语标签/IFU及授权
key_documents.en: Certificates, DoC, technical documentation, Turkish labeling/IFU and authorization letters

premarket_checks.zh: 证书接受条件、ÜTS状态、追溯和经营要求
premarket_checks.en: Certificate acceptance conditions, ÜTS status, traceability and operating requirements

task.zh: 冻结名称、型号、用途、适应症、人群、使用场景和作用原理
task.en: Freeze product name, models, intended use, indications, patient population, use environment and mechanism of action

note.zh: 作为四国分类和临床策略输入
note.en: Input for classification and clinical strategy in all four markets

task.zh: 确认是否 IVD、植入、无菌、有源、软件、组合产品或特殊材料
task.en: Confirm whether the device is an IVD, implantable, sterile, active, software, a combination product or contains special materials

note.zh: 本表按非 IVD 一般医疗器械；IVD另选法规
note.en: This checklist assumes a general non-IVD medical device; IVDs follow separate regulations

task.zh: 分别建立四国分类规则、适用理由及产品分组文件
task.en: Prepare classification rules, rationale and product grouping documents for each of the four markets

note.zh: 中国 III 类不直接等于各市场 III 类或最高风险类
note.en: China Class III does not automatically equal Class III or the highest risk class in other markets

task.zh: 核对制造商、场地、外包和 QMS证书范围/有效期
task.en: Check manufacturer, sites, outsourced processes and QMS certificate scope/validity

note.zh: ISO 13485不代表自动获得各市场准入
note.en: ISO 13485 does not automatically grant market access in any market

task.zh: 编制产品描述、设计制造、安全性能及适用标准清单
task.en: Prepare device description, design and manufacturing information, safety and performance data and list of applicable standards

note.zh: 标准认可和版本须按市场核对
note.en: Standard recognition and versions must be checked market by market

task.zh: 准备风险计划、报告及获益风险结论
task.en: Prepare risk management plan, report and benefit-risk conclusion

note.zh: 覆盖生命周期、可用性和残余风险
note.en: Cover the full lifecycle, usability and residual risks

task.zh: 核对性能、电气/EMC、生物相容性等适用报告
task.en: Check applicable reports such as performance, electrical safety/EMC and biocompatibility

note.zh: 只保留与产品属性有关的试验
note.en: Keep only tests relevant to the device's characteristics

task.zh: 核对灭菌、包装运输、有效期、软件/网络安全证据
task.en: Check sterilization, packaging and transport, shelf life and software/cybersecurity evidence

note.zh: 依据具体器械和市场判断适用性
note.en: Determine applicability by device and market

task.zh: 建立临床评价/研究策略及证据差距表
task.en: Define the clinical evaluation/investigation strategy and an evidence gap table

note.zh: 不得假定高风险产品一律可用文献或等同性替代试验
note.en: Do not assume literature or equivalence can always replace clinical investigations for high-risk devices

task.zh: 建立各市场标签/IFU、翻译、符号和标识清单
task.en: Prepare a per-market list of labeling/IFU, translations, symbols and markings

note.zh: 语言例外、公证认证要求按具体文件核查
note.en: Check language exemptions and notarization/legalization requirements document by document

task.zh: 建立投诉、警戒、召回、变更及续期责任表
task.en: Set up a responsibility matrix for complaints, vigilance, recalls, changes and renewals

note.zh: 时限、渠道和周期以当地现行规定为准
note.en: Timelines, channels and intervals follow current local regulations

task.zh: 确认 SFDA分类及 MDMA申请路径
task.en: Confirm SFDA classification and MDMA application route

note.zh: 中国 III 类不自动等于 Class D
note.en: China Class III does not automatically equal Class D

task.zh: 委任沙特授权代表并核对许可、职责和期限
task.en: Appoint a Saudi Authorized Representative and check its license, responsibilities and term

note.zh: 以境外制造商相关要求为准
note.en: Follow the requirements for foreign manufacturers

task.zh: 准备制造商/场地、QMS、授权和账户资料
task.en: Prepare manufacturer/site, QMS, authorization and account documents

note.zh: 核对当前平台、格式及主体资质
note.en: Check the current platform, formats and entity qualifications

task.zh: 准备 MDMA表单、技术文档、风险、性能及临床资料
task.en: Prepare MDMA forms, technical documentation, risk, performance and clinical data

note.zh: 按现行 MDS-REQ1及对应路径做差距评估
note.en: Run a gap assessment against current MDS-REQ1 and the applicable route

task.zh: 核对阿拉伯语/英语标签、IFU及 Saudi-DI要求
task.en: Check Arabic/English labeling, IFU and Saudi-DI requirements

note.zh: 按使用者、器械类别和当前实施状态确认
note.en: Confirm by user type, device class and current implementation status

task.zh: 确认费用、提交补正、许可范围及进口经营资质
task.en: Confirm fees, submission and deficiency responses, authorization scope and import/distribution licenses

note.zh: MDMA与经营者许可、上市后义务分别管理
note.en: Manage MDMA, establishment licenses and post-market obligations separately

task.zh: 依据 RDC 751/2022及修订确认类别、产品分组和路径
task.en: Confirm class, product grouping and route under RDC 751/2022 and its amendments

note.zh: III/IV类一般医疗器械通常走 registro；IVD另查
note.en: Class III/IV general medical devices usually follow registro; check IVDs separately

task.zh: 确定境内注册持有人，核对 AFE及本地经营许可
task.en: Designate the Brazilian registration holder and check AFE and local operating licenses

note.zh: 明确持证权、经销关系和资料获取权
note.en: Clarify registration ownership, distribution relationships and access to documents

task.zh: 核对制造场地 GMP/CBPF要求及可接受凭证
task.en: Check GMP/CBPF requirements for manufacturing sites and acceptable evidence

note.zh: 证书、受理或其他路径的接受条件须核实
note.en: Verify acceptance conditions for certificates, pending applications or other routes

task.zh: 判断 INMETRO等本地符合性认证是否适用
task.en: Determine whether INMETRO or other local conformity certification applies

note.zh: 不是所有器械均需此认证
note.en: Not all devices require this certification

task.zh: 准备注册表单、技术卷宗、性能/临床证据及声明
task.en: Prepare registration forms, technical dossier, performance/clinical evidence and declarations

note.zh: 按现行目录和具体产品准备
note.en: Prepare according to the current document list and the specific product

task.zh: 完成葡萄牙语标签/IFU及文件翻译认证核查
task.en: Complete Portuguese labeling/IFU and check translation and certification of documents

note.zh: 公证认证不应笼统列为全部材料必需
note.en: Do not list notarization/legalization as required for all documents by default

task.zh: 确认费用、申报补正、注册范围及变更/上市后要求
task.en: Confirm fees, submission and deficiency responses, registration scope and change/post-market requirements

note.zh: 注册证不替代进口经营资质
note.en: Registration does not replace import and operating licenses

task.zh: 按 MDR Annex VIII分类并确定符合性评估路线
task.en: Classify under MDR Annex VIII and determine the conformity assessment route

note.zh: 不能直接照搬中国 III 类结论
note.en: Do not carry over the China Class III conclusion directly

task.zh: 确认 EU授权代表、PRRC、进口商及分销商职责
task.en: Confirm the responsibilities of the EU Authorized Representative, PRRC, importer and distributors

note.zh: 核对 MDR Articles 11、13、14、15
note.en: Check MDR Articles 11, 13, 14 and 15

task.zh: 选择产品指定范围匹配的 NB并启动评审
task.en: Select an NB whose designation scope covers the device and start the assessment

note.zh: MDR III类通常需 NB介入；核对 NANDO范围
note.en: MDR Class III usually requires NB involvement; check the scope in NANDO

task.zh: 完成 Annex II/III、GSPR checklist、QMS和验证证据
task.en: Complete Annex II/III documentation, GSPR checklist, QMS and verification evidence

note.zh: 按所选评估程序组织
note.en: Organize according to the selected assessment procedure

task.zh: 确认临床研究、PMCF、SSCP和植入卡适用性
task.en: Confirm applicability of clinical investigations, PMCF, SSCP and implant card

note.zh: III类/植入器械额外要求与例外需产品级判断
note.en: Additional requirements and exemptions for Class III/implantable devices need product-level assessment

task.zh: 核对 NB证书、EU DoC、CE标识及德语标签/IFU
task.en: Check the NB certificate, EU DoC, CE marking and German labeling/IFU

note.zh: 新 MDR路径与合法旧指令过渡路径分开判断
note.en: Assess the new MDR route and the legacy-directive transition route separately

task.zh: 核对 SRN、UDI、EUDAMED强制模块和存量过渡期
task.en: Check SRN, UDI, mandatory EUDAMED modules and transition periods for devices already on the market

note.zh: 2026模块状态敏感，须复核欧委会最新公告
note.en: EUDAMED module status in 2026 is time-sensitive; recheck the latest European Commission notices

task.zh: 按所在地/角色核查 MPDG、州主管机关和通知义务
task.en: Check MPDG, competent state authority and notification obligations by location and role

note.zh: 一般 CE准入不等于另办德国独立产品注册证
note.en: General CE market access does not require a separate German product registration certificate

task.zh: 落实 PMS、PSUR、PMCF、警戒和证书监督
task.en: Implement PMS, PSUR, PMCF, vigilance and certificate surveillance

note.zh: 周期和报告对象按实际类别及现行规定核对
note.en: Check intervals and reporting recipients against the actual class and current rules

task.zh: 确认土耳其现行分类、合规路线和过渡条款
task.en: Confirm current Turkish classification, conformity route and transitional provisions

note.zh: 不能把中国 III类或欧盟证书当成本地分类结论
note.en: Do not treat China Class III or an EU certificate as the local classification outcome

task.zh: 确认土耳其授权代表、进口商和 ÜTS操作主体
task.en: Confirm the Turkish Authorized Representative, importer and the entity operating in ÜTS

note.zh: 按制造商所在地及运营者角色核查
note.en: Check by manufacturer location and economic operator role

task.zh: 核对 CE证书、DoC、NB范围及本地接受条件
task.en: Check CE certificate, DoC, NB scope and local acceptance conditions

note.zh: CE不代表全部土耳其本地手续已完成
note.en: CE marking does not mean all Turkish local formalities are complete

task.zh: 办理所需 ÜTS企业资料和授权文件核验
task.en: Complete the required ÜTS company records and verification of authorization documents

note.zh: 翻译公证、材料形式、系统角色须当前确认
note.en: Translation/notarization, document format and system roles must be confirmed against current rules

task.zh: 办理 ÜTS产品记录及关联证书/声明
task.en: Create ÜTS product records and link certificates/declarations

note.zh: 核对企业、产品和证书信息一致性
note.en: Check consistency of company, product and certificate data

task.zh: 核对土耳其语标签/IFU、UDI及本地标识
task.en: Check Turkish labeling/IFU, UDI and local markings

note.zh: 语言例外及追溯要求依产品判断
note.en: Language exemptions and traceability requirements depend on the product

task.zh: 落实 ÜTS追溯、警戒、召回和记录变更
task.en: Maintain ÜTS traceability, vigilance, recalls and record changes

note.zh: 明确制造商、AR和进口商持续责任
note.en: Define the ongoing responsibilities of the manufacturer, AR and importer

org.zh: SFDA 医疗器械官方入口

topic.zh: 核对现行 MDS-REQ1、分类、AR、Saudi-DI和警戒指南
topic.en: Check current MDS-REQ1, classification, AR, Saudi-DI and vigilance guidance
Check RDC 751/2022 and amendments, GMP/CBPF requirements

org.zh: ANVISA 医疗器械主题入口

topic.zh: 注册服务、AFE、INMETRO适用性及上市后事项
topic.en: Registration services, AFE, INMETRO applicability and post-market matters

topic.zh: 查合并文本、修订、过渡条款及附件
topic.en: Consolidated text, amendments, transitional provisions and annexes
NB designation scope, NANDO and implementation guidance

topic.zh: 核对模块强制适用日期及各主体/存量产品过渡期
topic.en: Check mandatory application dates of modules and transition periods for each actor and for legacy devices

topic.zh: 核对现行 Tıbbi Cihaz Yönetmeliği及公告
topic.en: Check the current Tıbbi Cihaz Yönetmeliği (Medical Device Regulation) and announcements

topic.zh: 核对企业/产品登记、文件形式和追溯要求
topic.en: Check company/product registration, document formats and traceability requirements
